headline: Oil Prices Climb Near $120 Amid Escalating U.S.-Iran Tensions
summary: ICE Brent crude oil hovered near $118 per barrel as fears of renewed U.S.-Iran hostilities intensified following reported attacks near the Strait of Hormuz and Iranian ports.
why: Crude oil is a critical global commodity input. Supply disruptions and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East directly affect global energy prices and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Rising military tensions and attacks near Hormuz directly drive up oil trading prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Fears of renewed U.S.-Iran hostilities and attacks near key shipping lanes escalated supply disruption risks, pushing Brent crude higher.
